subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing (PulseStream Engine)
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz time-series sensor payloads from IoT edge devices, bike computers and smart wearables; enforces physical metric boundaries, reconciles out-of-order backfills, buffers windowed telemetry streams for streaming analytics and broadcasts to downstream event streams.
subdomain.why_distinct: Owns the rules and lifecycle of raw telemetry (validation, reordering by device time, append-only revisions) within the endurance athletic analytics platform; a differentiating capability with its own language and cadence (1Hz bursts).

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry).
Raw transmission received from a device, carrying one or more Telemetry Samples.
Epoch timestamp generated by the device; the chronological ordering key.
Arrival time at the engine; never used for chronological ordering.
60-second window within which delayed out-of-order packets are re-indexed chronologically.
Demand-driven flow control so burst loads are handled with zero blocking I/O.
Physical physiological/mechanical limit for a metric (HR 30–240 BPM, Power 0–2500W, Cadence 0–220 RPM, Swimming Pace >45 sec/100m).
Status flag tagged on an invalid sample; the payload is kept, not dropped.
Appended record representing a corrective or backfilled frame; earlier records are never mutated.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Intake
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Non-blocking entry point receiving Ingress Packets from devices under backpressure.
invariants: Ingestion entry point maintains reactive-stream backpressure with zero blocking I/O on thread pools under burst loads (thousands of simultaneous 1Hz transmissions)
source_of_truth: Transient in-flight Ingress Packets (no persisted truth)

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Validation
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Validates each Telemetry Sample against Sensor Metric Boundaries and flags failures without dropping payload.
invariants: Every raw 1Hz sample is validated against Sensor Metric Boundaries before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and the underlying payload is never dropped

bounded_contexts.name: Backfill Reordering
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Re-indexes late/out-of-order samples chronologically by t_device within the Backfill Reorder Window and buffers windowed streams for analytics.
invariants: Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed chronologically by t_device, never by t_ingress

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Log
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Append-only auditable history of raw time-series records and their revisions; broadcasts to downstream event streams.
invariants: Raw time-series records are strictly append-only
Corrective or backfilled frames append new event revisions; nothing is mutated
source_of_truth: Raw telemetry records and Event Revisions

assumptions.item: AMBIGUITY (boundary question): inbound delivery posture is unstated. If at-least-once (retries/replay), what identity distinguishes a retry from a new Event Revision: client-supplied key, or natural identity (device, metric, t_device)? If natural, is the mutable payload (corrected value) part of identity or excluded, and what then separates a retry from a correction? Without an answer, corrections may become no-op duplicates or retries mint false revisions.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Dedup duty belongs to Telemetry Intake or Telemetry Event Log; undecided.

assumptions.item: Metrics named without ranges: ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry. No range invented; posture unbounded/validation disabled pending operator answer. Single list for operator: [ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke telemetry]. Swimming Pace given only as lower bound >45 sec/100m, no upper bound.
Single subdomain split into four contexts by rule ownership (flow control, validation, ordering, append-only log); description names one domain.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could merge into one context if the team treats them as one model.

assumptions.item: Broadcasting to downstream event streams placed in Telemetry Event Log; description gives no broadcast rules beyond backpressure-awareness.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: May warrant a separate context if broadcast rules emerge.

assumptions.item: Samples later than the 60s window are not specified (rejected vs appended as revision); needs owner decision.
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Affects Backfill Reordering vs Telemetry Event Log responsibility.
